title: Not My Tempo: the metronome you talk to while you play
description: Say start, faster or tempo 120 and the click follows, without taking your hands off the instrument. The full metronome and voice control are free.

hero.headline:

hero.lead: Say `faster` mid-phrase and the click speeds up. No reaching for the screen, no stopping to change the tempo.
hero.cta: Get it free on the App Store
hero.note: The full metronome and voice control are free.

demo.title: Try it out loud
demo.lead: Tap a phrase, or turn on the mic and say it. Turn your volume up, it clicks.
demo.micNone: This browser can't recognize speech. Tap a phrase instead.
demo.note: This web demo uses your browser's speech recognition. The app recognizes speech on your device.

problem.title: Ever lost the groove just to nudge the tempo?
problem.text: Put the bow down, clamp the pick in your teeth, tap the screen twice, and the feel you just found is gone. Not My Tempo changes the tempo with a single word, right where you are.

features.title: Say it, and it follows
features.text:
Short English words like `start`, `faster` and `tempo 120`. It listens the moment you open it, with no need to turn on iOS Voice Control or any Accessibility setting.
Forget a command? Say `help` and every phrase you can use shows up on screen.

features.title: See the beat, too
features.text:
Pick a bouncing ball, an orbit or a ring. Beat one shows in red and clicks louder.
Tap along on the orbit and it shows how close you landed.

features.title: Save the accents for every song
features.text: Set each click in the bar to high, low or silent, then keep it as a preset. Build the bossa nova or samba pattern once and just pick it next time. (Pro)

items.title: Allow the mic
items.text: It asks for microphone and speech access once.

items.title: Talk or tap
items.text: Every command also has an on-screen control.

reference.title: What you can say
rows: twice as fast, half as fast
climb the tempo as you drill (Pro)
reference.note: Voice recognition runs in US English. Every command also works by tapping.

pricing.title: The metronome is free. Pro is there when you want more.

pro.note: Yearly with a free trial, or a one-time lifetime purchase

pricing.note: Voice control and accessibility features stay free for everyone. Bought the app before Pro existed? Every Pro feature is already yours.

items.a: Voice recognition runs in US English, so commands are short English words like `start` and `faster`. The rest of the app is in your language, and every command also works by tapping.
Check that the mic status reads Listening. If it's off, tap Listen. In a noisy room or on loudspeakers, use earphones so the click doesn't leak into the mic.
To save battery, listening switches off after a few minutes without a command. Tap Listen to turn it back on.

items.q: The tempo came out half or double.
How do I use the tuner?
items.a: Say `tune` or tap the waveform button on the tempo card. Play a note; when the indicator lands in the green zone, you're in tune. Say `close` to leave.

items.q: I already use iOS Voice Control.
items.a: Turn the app's own mic off and drive it by button name. Every control has a VoiceOver label.
No. Speech is recognized on your device and never recorded, stored or uploaded. The metronome, voice control and tuner all work offline.

items.q: How do I cancel the subscription?
items.a: In Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions. The yearly plan renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends. Lifetime is a single charge.
